# Jubilees Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Abraham's Death; The Great Apocalypse

---

**23:1** And he placed Jacob's two hands on his eyes and he blessed God. And he laid his face over Jacob's face and kissed him and said: "May the LORD God be blessed, and may his name be blessed forever and ever, who has given to me Jacob as a pure son and a holy seed. For he is mine. May he be mine forever and ever."

**23:2** And he said: "My son, I command you: keep my commandments, and walk in the ways of your father Abraham."

**23:3** And Abraham died in the forty-third jubilee, in the sixth year of the seventh week, and he lived one hundred and seventy-five years. He completed those years of his life in peace.

**23:4** For the days of the first of the ancients, of their lives, were nineteen jubilees, and after the Flood they began to grow less than nineteen jubilees, and to decrease in jubilees, and to grow old quickly, and to be full of their days on account of the manifold tribulations and the wickedness of their ways.

**23:5** And all of them who are wicked are accounted, their days are being made shorter.

**23:6** And in those days Noah was five hundred years old before he begot Shem. And in his days Methuselah lived nine hundred and sixty-nine years.

**23:7** For the Most High was angry on account of the works of the men of the generation of the Flood; for their hearts were corrupted, their thoughts stained throughout all their days.

**23:8** And after the Flood the years of the lives of men began to diminish from one hundred years to seventy years, and from seventy years to fifty years, and from fifty years to forty years, and from forty years to thirty-five years, and from thirty-five years to thirty, and from thirty to twenty-five, and from twenty-five to twenty.

**23:9** And old age will begin after twenty years, and he will pass his former days in sorrow and tribulation.

**23:10** And there will be no old man nor one who is satisfied with his days, for all will be like children and youths.

**23:11** And all their works will be in confusion and with evil intent, and in all their abominable deeds one will pollute another.

**23:12** And then he who is ten years old will say: "An old man of eighty years has not passed his years in his life, and he is like a youth of five years."

**23:13** And all will be like a child of three years, and will have no understanding concerning the path in which to walk.

**23:14** And in those days the children will begin to study the laws, and to seek the commandments, and to return to the path of righteousness.

**23:15** And the days will begin to grow many and increase amongst those children of men till their days draw near to one thousand years, and to a greater number of years than before was the number of the days.

**23:16** And there will be no old man and none in those days who is weary with age or afflicted with evil, for all will be as young men and children during all their days.

**23:17** And they will complete and live their whole life in peace and in joy, and there will be no Satan nor any evil destroyer: for all their days will be days of blessing and healing.

**23:18** And at that time the LORD will heal his servants, and they shall rise up and see great peace, and drive out their adversaries. And the righteous shall see and be thankful, and rejoice with joy forever and ever, and shall see all their judgments and all their curses on their enemies.

**23:19** And their bones shall rest in the earth, and their spirits shall have much joy, and they shall know that it is the LORD who executes judgment, and shows mercy to hundreds and thousands and to all that love him.

**23:20** And you, Moses, write down all these words; for thus are they written, and thus are they recorded on the heavenly tablets of the divisions of the days of the law and of the testimony and of the events of the years and of their weeks and of the jubilees throughout all the years of the world, even until the day of the new creation when the heaven and earth and all their creatures shall be renewed like the powers of heaven and like all the creatures of the earth, until the day when the sanctuary of the LORD shall be made in Jerusalem on Mount Zion, and all the luminaries be renewed for healing and for peace and for blessing for all the elect of Israel, and that thus it may be from that day and unto all the days of the earth.

---
*EMET notes: Chapter 23 contains Jubilees' "little apocalypse" — a compressed history of human decline and eschatological renewal. The lifespan reduction scheme (vv.4-13) is a unique Jubilees contribution to apocalyptic literature. V.20 is the great culminating verse linking all of history to the heavenly tablets and the new creation.*
